A.text: Money invested: Nani Tuitions says "11,000 crore" over its own "7,000 Cr+" end card; six other videos say 7,000.
Users: most end cards say 50 lakh; the podcast ad says 60 lakh in speech over a 50L+ end card.
FD rate behind the lounge card: 8.5%, 8.10% and 8% across three presenter videos; one says 8% while its ad text says 8.5%.
Lounge visits: 8 free in six videos and one image ad, 10 free in another image ad.
Bonds: "9 to 12%" in speech, while the app screen in the same Papa ad lists bonds at 8.00% to 9.75%.

B.text: Tenure: every end card says "3 Month Tenure Bond"; app lists in the same ads show 20 months and 18 months.
Minimum: "sirf 1000 rupay se" spoken over an app list showing Min. 10k; other ads say 10,000.
Payout: "monthly interest" on nine image ads and in three video ideas, on a 3 month bond; one app screen says interest quarterly.
Rate: 11% on the card, 11.75% on one image ad, and 9 to 12% in speech and in every disclaimer.
Exit: "sell at any time, no questions asked" against captions that a sale depends on a buyer.
